display.purpose: Rare full-screen headline moment (e.g. onboarding). Not used in daily-use screens.

message.purpose: The workhorse size: chat bubble text and primary reading content.

caption.purpose: Secondary metadata: status text, card word labels.

label.purpose: Small emphasis labels, used sparingly (strategy badges).

shadows.name: whisper
shadows.purpose: Default for chat bubbles and the status pill. Barely perceptible presence, not depth.

shadows.name: held
shadows.purpose: Modal dialogs — a firmer lift because it interrupts the flow.

shadows.name: called-out
shadows.purpose: The primary CTA button and AI avatar, tinted with the component's own color rather than black.

motion.name: press-spring
motion.purpose: Button press feedback. Soft, not snappy — no elastic overshoot.

motion.name: pulse-listening
motion.purpose: Gentle breathing pulse while actively listening or recording.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main call-to-action per screen ("我想和你聊聊" / talk-to-me). Full pill, tinted colored shadow, scales down softly on press.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; height: 64px; padding: 0 24px; background: #C17B6A; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'Lexend', sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1.5px; border: none; border-radius: 32px; box-shadow: 0 8px 16px rgba(193,123,106,0.2); transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-btn-icon { opacity: 0.9; }

components.name: Emotion Chip
components.description: Small informational tag under a chat bubble showing detected acoustic emotion. Not interactive.
components.css: .ds-chip-emotion { display: inline-block; padding: 3px 10px; background: rgba(193,123,106,0.15); color: #3D231B; font-family: 'Lexend', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 12px; }

components.name: Category Chip
components.description: Small informational tag showing the psychological category the router assigned. Slightly lower emphasis than the emotion chip.
components.css: .ds-chip-category { display: inline-block; padding: 3px 10px; background: rgba(193,123,106,0.08); color: #7A6E68; font-family: 'Lexend', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: 0.5px solid rgba(193,123,106,0.20); border-radius: 12px; }

components.name: Assistant Chat Bubble
components.description: AI reply bubble: round avatar, paper-white bubble with a hairline border, tail corner flattened toward the avatar.
components.html:
伴
您可以随时对我说话，我会一直在这里陪着您。
components.css: .ds-bubble-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 8px; } .ds-avatar { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 18px; background: #C17B6A; color: #FFFFFF; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: 'Lexend', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(193,123,106,0.2); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-bubble-assistant { max-width: 82%; padding: 14px 18px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #2D2320; font-family: 'Lexend', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; line-height: 28px; border: 1px solid #E8E0DB; border-radius: 24px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; }

components.name: User Chat Bubble
components.description: The resident's own message, right-aligned, filled with the Blush Container tint rather than the paper-white used for assistant replies.
components.css: .ds-bubble-user { max-width: 82%; margin-left: auto; padding: 14px 18px; background: #F5E4DE; color: #3D231B; font-family: 'Lexend', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; line-height: 28px; border-radius: 24px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Memory Card (matched)
components.description: The single positive-feedback state in the memory game. No negative state exists by design.
components.css: .ds-card-matched { width: 92px; height: 92px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; background: #F5E4DE; border: 1px solid #F5E4DE; border-radius: 12px; } .ds-card-word { font-family: 'Lexend', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #6B5E58; }

components.name: Confirm Dialog
components.description: Modal confirmation, e.g. ending a session. Firmer shadow than any other surface since it must read as clearly above the rest of the screen.
components.html:
结束对话？
确定要结束这次聊天吗？
components.css: .ds-dialog-overlay { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.25); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 40px; } .ds-dialog { background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 24px; padding: 28px; max-width: 340px; width: 100%; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.12); } .ds-dialog-title { font-family: 'Lexend', sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: #2D2320; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-dialog-message { font-family: 'Lexend', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 24px; color: #6B5E58; margin-bottom: 24px; } .ds-dialog-actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 12px; } .ds-dialog-cancel { padding: 10px 20px; background: #F5F1ED; color: #6B5E58; font-family: 'Lexend', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 12px; } .ds-dialog-confirm { padding: 10px 20px; background: #C17B6A; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'Lexend', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 12px; }

components.name: Bottom Tab Bar
components.description: Text-only bottom navigation (icons deliberately removed). Active tab tinted Dusty Rose.
components.html: 聊聊天练练脑我自己
components.css: .ds-tabbar { display: flex; height: 72px; padding-bottom: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-around; background: #FFFFFF; border-top: 1px solid #E8E0DB; } .ds-tab { font-family: 'Lexend', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: #6B5E58; } .ds-tab-active { color: #C17B6A; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview: AgeTalker exists for one quiet hour at a time: a resident alone with their phone, wanting to be heard. Every screen behaves like a calm room, not a control panel. Nothing blinks for attention, nothing scores or streaks the user, nothing announces itself with urgency. Warmth is carried structurally, through dusty-rose and warm cream held at low saturation, through generous rounded shapes, and through type that stays large and unhurried rather than dense. This system explicitly rejects three lanes: it is not a medical-device interface, not a tech-company product, and not a children's app. It is an adult companion, dressed like a warm, unhurried living room rather than a screen.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, desaturated dusty-rose + cream palette; near-black text tinted warm, never pure #000
Single humanist typeface (Lexend) at generous sizes throughout
Pill and soft-rounded-rectangle shapes everywhere; no sharp corners
Shadows nearly flat (ambient, opacity 0.04-0.12); lift appears only where it matters
No badges, streaks, red dots, or urgency-driven UI patterns anywhere in the resident-facing surface

rules.name: The One Warm Hue Rule
rules.body: Every color in the system is a tint or shade of the same warm rose/umber hue family. No cool gray, no blue-black, no unrelated second hue.

rules.name: The Caregiver-Only Red Rule
rules.body: #D4453B never colors the ambient experience (background aura, dialog copy, chrome), even during an actual crisis — that stays warm amber. The one exception is the Contact Caregiver action button itself, which is allowed to be red so it reads as unmistakably actionable against an otherwise calm screen.

rules.name: The No-Small-Print Rule
rules.body: 13px is the type-size floor. Nothing in the resident-facing UI goes smaller.

rules.name: The Earned Lift Rule
rules.body: Shadow strength scales with how much a component deserves attention, not with its structural importance in code.

dos: Do keep every color a tint or shade of the dusty-rose/warm-umber hue family.
Do use full pill shapes for primary actions and generous (12-24px) radii everywhere else.
Do keep shadows near-flat by default (opacity <= 0.12) and reserve stronger lift for the one primary action per screen.
Do keep body text at 18px/28px line-height minimum for close reading; never go below 13px anywhere.
Do route anything urgent or crisis-related through warm amber, never red, on any resident-facing screen.
donts: Don't introduce cold blues/grays, alarm-red, or instrument-panel precision.
Don't add oversized rounded mascots, candy colors, or bouncy/elastic easing.
Don't use dark-mode-by-default, neon accents, geometric hard edges, or dashboard-style chrome.
Don't add popups, red notification dots, badges, streaks, or marketing-voice copy anywhere.
Don't put a decorative icon above every tab bar label by default; text-only labels were a deliberate choice.
Don't give the memory game a negative-feedback color or shake animation on a mismatch.
